blocker_policy: A tier is externally blocked only when no testable provider, public source, user-owned import, fixture, or scripted capability can prove a required contract. Missing alternative providers and production credentials are adapter backlog or runtime dependencies, not blockers. T6 real-time market behavior is the current exception.

tiers.name: Swing trader product
tiers.track_profile: One CN anchor journey. Shared tools retain track-neutral contracts; the already enumerated HK/US source packages prove their exact bounded operations without duplicating the whole swing journey.
tiers.product_outcome: A CN swing trader can select an exact listing; acquire supported daily market, calendar, rule, universe, event, classification, and provenance inputs; screen and inspect it; calculate technicals; create and simulate a plan; and resume an auditable journal-backed review loop. Exact HK/US input operations remain separately labelled capabilities, not duplicate role products.

blockers.exit: At least one CN-anchor daily quote/OHLCV adapter is testable and the provider port can accept additional explicit adapters without changing the product contract.
blockers.resolution: Eastmoney already supplies the bounded CN quote/history implementation and deterministic adapter evidence. Tushare Pro is the second mainstream conformance adapter; its caller-owned token is an environment-only opt-in test/runtime dependency. Other providers are future adapter breadth, not a tier blocker.

blockers.exit: At least one testable source/import seam exists for universe and event inputs, while exact identity, time, correction, rights and receipt behavior remains mandatory implementation work.
blockers.resolution: Existing Eastmoney, CNINFO, official calendar/rule, CAPCO and user-owned fixture/import seams are sufficient to implement and test the CN journey. Implementing their exact adapters and honest limitations belongs to the T1 build, not pre-build blocker resolution.

blockers.exit: The complete CN-anchor journey and its receipt, failure, recovery and lifecycle acceptance contract are specified before implementation.
blockers.resolution: Sessions 40, 45 and 46 plus the existing swing acceptance evidence specify the journey. Replacing historical fixtures with the completed Eastmoney/Tushare-capable T1 path and making the lane pass are tier implementation and verification work.

tiers.name: Long-term equity investor product
tiers.track_profile: One US/SEC anchor journey. CN/HK proposals prove their market-owned source and calculation contracts inside the same tier; they do not create two more investor-product acceptance matrices.
tiers.product_outcome: A US long-term investor can complete a cited company review from original filings and exact accounting/ownership/event evidence through normalized fundamentals, comparisons, valuation, quality/growth, governance, thesis, and a reproducible research report. CN/HK capabilities remain exact and isolated without duplicating the full journey.

blockers.exit: Named primary-document sources or bounded user-owned imports are testable for the anchor journey.
blockers.resolution: SEC, CNINFO, exchange/HKEX and bounded import seams are already specified and testable; exact decoders, attachment handling, rights and limitations remain T2 implementation requirements rather than pre-build blockers.

blockers.exit: Every company-intelligence input has a testable provider or bounded import adapter seam.
blockers.resolution: The reviewed contracts permit provider adapters and user-owned imports. Provider breadth and production credentials are runtime/backlog concerns; exact authority, timing, coverage and correction facts are implemented and tested inside T2.

blockers.exit: The long-term-investor journey is completely specified before implementation.
blockers.resolution: Sessions 40, 42, 45 and 46 specify the journey; implementing and passing it remains the T2 build/verification outcome, not a pre-build blocker.

tiers.name: Portfolio manager and monitoring product
tiers.track_profile: One mixed portfolio/import journey whose CN, HK, and US legs remain separately labelled; no per-track portfolio product or repeated journey.
tiers.product_outcome: A portfolio owner or manager can import and reconcile holdings, calculate risk/scenario/attribution/rebalance/tax-lot facts, define durable company and portfolio monitors, receive separately authorized alerts, resume across sessions, and audit every state and notification event.

blockers.exit: A user-owned local durable-storage capability is available for deterministic implementation and testing.
blockers.resolution: The reviewed local append-only/versioned storage contract is implementable without an external provider; adapter implementation and lifecycle proof belong to T3.

blockers.exit: A scripted/local notification capability can prove the effect contract without external delivery credentials.
blockers.resolution: Notification providers are optional adapters. Deterministic scripted delivery proves bounded retry, idempotency, privacy and failure behavior; production credentials are runtime configuration.

blockers.exit: A bounded user-owned portfolio import path is available.
blockers.resolution: The implemented CSV/JSON portfolio import is sufficient to build the anchor journey; broker retrieval is future adapter breadth, not a blocker.

tiers.name: Quant researcher product
tiers.track_profile: One US point-in-time dataset/replay anchor journey. Provider-neutral manifests preserve other declared tracks without three separate quant acceptance runs.
tiers.product_outcome: A quant researcher can bind a point-in-time universe and dataset, calculate explicit market/factor/event features, execute bounded replay and backtests, compare declared trials, and reproduce the complete run from canonical manifests without survivorship, vintage, or experiment-ledger ambiguity.

blockers.exit: A bounded point-in-time dataset/import seam is available for reproducible implementation and testing.
blockers.resolution: Canonical manifests, user-owned imports and scripted provider fixtures can prove the US-anchor replay contract. Additional historical providers are adapter breadth rather than pre-build blockers.

blockers.exit: The quant journey is completely specified before implementation.
blockers.resolution: Sessions 16, 28, 40, 42, 45 and 46 specify the journey; passing it remains T4 implementation/verification work.

tiers.name: Macro and multi-asset researcher product
tiers.track_profile: Global and cross-market labelled legs, not an equity track. CN-specific instruments remain explicit source legs and never create cn/hk/us product variants.
tiers.product_outcome: A multi-asset researcher can identify exact fund, bond, convertible, option, future, commodity, crypto, macro, rate, and FX legs; acquire supported source evidence; run the reviewed calculations; and compose separately labelled global comparisons without equity-track leakage.

blockers.exit: Each instrument family permits a provider adapter or bounded user-owned import seam.
blockers.resolution: Provider-neutral ports, public sources and bounded imports are sufficient to implement T5. Supporting more providers is focused adapter breadth and never a role/provider matrix.

blockers.exit: Dated authoritative or explicitly bounded reference inputs are available to fixtures/import adapters.
blockers.resolution: Session 43 identifies the required source roles and bounded import behavior. Exact adapters and dated reference evidence are T5 implementation work, not an external pre-build stop.

blockers.exit: The multi-asset journey is completely specified before implementation.
blockers.resolution: Sessions 40, 43, 45 and 46 specify the journey; implementation and acceptance remain T5 work.

tiers.name: Three-track day trader and execution-review product
tiers.track_profile: One composed day-trader acceptance profile with mandatory, separately labelled cn, hk, and us live-session and transaction-tape legs. Shared workflow logic is exercised once while Futu transaction-ticker/tape conformance, market identity, rights, clocks, sequence, conditions, recovery, and unsupported venues are proved independently for each track; no track leg is inferred from another and no provider-by-track matrix is created.
tiers.product_outcome: A CN, HK, or US day trader can acquire and inspect authenticated track-owned live transaction-tape evidence, run the shared bounded session workflow, plan and simulate action locally, observe applicable read-only account and externally executed order/fill state, evaluate track-owned compliance facts, export a non-executable handoff, and reconcile imported or read-only receipts. Every result retains its exact track, venue, feed, entitlement, clocks, conditions, limitations, and receipt. Live provider acquisition is transaction-ticker/tape only: no Pi plugin acquires a stock quote, bid, offer, or order book; the existing stock_order_book proposal validates caller-supplied observations only. No Pi plugin can place, route, cancel, replace, or otherwise mutate any paper or live order.

blockers.exit: A caller-selected Futu direct Web API or another lawful gateway-free capability can be exercised in separate live sessions for all three required track legs: cn over proved XSHG/XSHE scope, hk over proved XHKG scope, and us over proved XNYS/XNAS scope. OpenD may supply development evidence only and can never be a runtime dependency or deliverable. Each exercise must independently validate its exact transaction-ticker feed and rights, authentic sequence domain, gap/reset and bounded recovery behavior, correction/cancel/bust availability or explicit absence, exchange/provider/receipt clocks, condition/type semantics, session coverage, backpressure behavior, and bounded unsubscribe/shutdown. Unsupported venues remain explicit and credentials, OpenD, remembered login state, stock quote/bid/offer/order-book data, and raw provider data remain outside the product.
The bounded streaming effect contract is fully specified and testable with scripted transports.
blockers.resolution: The private pure finance_tape stream state machine now implements and deterministically tests one-key generation-scoped subscription, bounded event/byte/queue/session handling, idempotent cancellation, one bounded reconnect plus overlap recovery, stale/late completion suppression, and confirmed or unconfirmed cleanup outcomes. It emits typed effects only; authentic provider real-time semantics remain under T6-INTRADAY-PROVIDERS.

blockers.exit: Read-only broker observation, caller-owned receipt import, deterministic local simulation, non-executable handoff and reconciliation ports are specified and testable without order mutation.
blockers.resolution: The controlling non-executing boundary forbids every plugin from placing, routing, cancelling, replacing or otherwise mutating paper or live orders. The completed product composes separately labelled cn, hk, and us read-only/import legs; Futu is the first selected external capability where its per-track authority is proved, and any other provider remains explicit optional breadth. Every credential is a caller-owned runtime input.

blockers.exit: The read-only access, private-data redaction, handoff, reconciliation and incident-evidence state machines are fully specified before implementation.
blockers.resolution: The repository's 2026-08-12 non-executing amendment supersedes earlier order-mutation designs. T6 implements evidence-only state machines and never accepts write-capable broker authority.

blockers.exit: Local simulation, imported external-paper receipts and failure-injection evidence are release gates rather than pre-build dependencies.
blockers.resolution: Paper behavior is deterministic local simulation or read-only review of caller-owned external receipts. It is not broker-hosted mutation and can never enable live mutation.
